articleTitle: The grid challenges for renewable energy — An overview and some priorities
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Integrating Renewable Energy to the Grid: Optimising and Securing the Network
abstract: We need vision and strategic oversight of investment in our national infrastructure. We need to consider the wider benefits of infrastructure investment, and the opportunity costs of not investing. We need some sight of distributed generation, and strategic governance of the distribution / transmission interface. We need appropriate triggers for timely grid investment and avoid excessive “non-firm” wastage of renewable resource. We need to develop the services offered to the networks.

articleTitle: Case study: Transmission and distribution network projects that are enabling the integration of renewables
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Integrating Renewable Energy to the Grid: Optimising and Securing the Network
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include; new challenges will exist for the stable operation of the transmission and distribution network; energy storage will help address a number of network related issues on networks with high levels of renewable generation; interconnectors will have a very significant role to play; real progress now being made with network technology helping to integrate new forms of renewable generation.
